couchdb.per_model_instances: ib_v1_couch_{1..5} on ports 5985-5989, each a byte copy of the source volume, started with src/couchdb/couchdb_setup.sh (same command as src/couchdb/docker-compose.yaml)
couchdb.source_volume: couchdb_couchdb-data (volume used by the submitted runs; copied, never modified)

config.note: Environment/scoring code is the working tree (mtime 2026-09-15, in effect for the submitted 09-25..27 runs), not git HEAD. Runner transport changes of 2026-10-30 are included and recorded by hash.

settings.episode_retry: A/E: up to 3 attempts on runner exceptions; no-verdict episodes whose only errors are transport errors are flagged infra_failure and re-run on resume; parse failures are model behaviour and are never re-run (Appendix A.1 convention)
settings.invalid_response_convention: missing/invalid verdict scored 0 for TDA (A.1); reported separately as malformed

urllib_runners(A,E,C,D_enterprise,B_lega.fallbacks: on HTTP 400 naming max_completion_tokens -> renamed; on HTTP 400 rejecting temperature -> temperature omitted (provider default). Not logged per call in the submitted runs.
